title: Nimir
desc: Selvam, a photographer, lives in a town with a small studio of his own. One day, when he gets assaulted, he decides to not wear his slippers until he gets revenge on the culprits.

title: Takkar
desc: A man who wants to be a millionaire meets a woman with a distaste for money. Their chance encounter, however, leads to an unexpected adventure.

title: Action Hero Biju
desc: Biju Poulose leaves his teaching job to pursue his dream of serving in the police force. Posted as the sub-inspector in Cochin, he has to handle notorious criminals who indulge in unlawful activities.

title: Race Gurram
desc: In an attempt to put an end to the schemes of their enemy, two brothers join forces and stop at nothing to destroy the reign of a gangster who aspires to be a politician.

title: Sangili Bungili Kadhava Thorae
desc: Vasu, a young broker, purchases a bungalow for his family in the outskirts of town. However, they soon start to feel the presence of supernatural forces in the building.

title: Rakshan the Ghost
desc: A former Interpol officer with a troubled past unleashes his skills in an attempt to protect his beloved family from kidnappers, rivals and death.

title: Max
desc: Inspector Arjun arrests two men for crashing into the police station. Soon, he desperately rushes to clear his name as the two are found dead.

title: Whistle Podu
desc: A man tries to fulfil his father's dream of opening a sports academy. However, complications arise when he becomes embroiled in a revenge scheme involving the mafia.

title: Veppam
desc: Karthik's life changes when his father exploits his friend for a drug-peddling assignment.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Ustaad Ram
desc: When identical twins reunite after parting ways during their childhood, they find themselves trapped in a labyrinth of secrets, deception and crime.

title: Annanukku Jey
desc: A toddy seller's son becomes a politician and overcomes multiple challenges in order to take revenge from the bar owner, who mistreated his father.

title: Oh Baby
desc: A seventy-year-old woman frustrated with her life, blames God for her misfortune. Subsequently, she magically transforms into a twenty-four-year-old after getting her photo taken at a studio.

title: Maharaja
desc: After his home is broken into, a barber sets out to get revenge and informs the police about the incident. However, the police are unsure about the missing entity in question.

title: Villain 2
desc: Ramu begins to look for his estranged brother, Rama, hoping to reunite him with their mother. However, he soon realises that his brother is now a part of a criminal organisation.

title: Ennodu Modhi Paar
desc: Karthikeya, a man who is devoted to his family, faces a huge challenge as his violent and turbulent past begins to resurface.

title: Bullet Raja
desc: Bullet Raja is killed by Babu, a goon, because both love the same girl. Bullet fights with the god of death and is sent back into the body of Ravindra, a minister who was killed by his own associates.
